name: Next Mission
tagline: Interviews service members and maps every rule and deadline before their out-date
description: Built for troops approaching retirement or separation from the military. It starts by interviewing you about your situation, then turns the answers into a dated checklist that works backward from your out-date. Each entry names the rule behind it, and the author has published the full playbook openly.
